content:
Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Service Selection Commission (UPSSSC) has released the Junior Assistant, Junior Clerk and Assistant Grade III Recruitment 2023 Final Result. The recruitment was advertised under Advt. No. 08-Exam/2023.

Candidates who appeared in the recruitment process can download the final result from the official UPSSSC website. The recruitment includes 5512 posts after the vacancy increase, including 3831 posts from the original advertisement and 1681 additional posts.

Important dates

  • Application period: 12 September 2023 to 03 October 2023
  • Correction last date: 10 October 2023
  • Eligibility result: 14 March 2024
  • Mains examination: 29 June 2025
  • Typing test result: 26 February 2026
  • Document upload last date: 06 June 2026
  • Final result: 09 September 2026

Eligibility and vacancy

Applicants were required to have a UPSSSC PET 2022 score card, Intermediate qualification, Hindi typing speed of 25 WPM, English typing speed of 30 WPM and a NIELIT CCC certificate. The original category-wise vacancy was General 1889, EWS 326, OBC 763, SC 770 and ST 83.

Use the final result link to download the result PDF. Candidates selected for document verification should also complete the document upload process through the UPSSSC login link.
